QuestInfo.name: Shadows in Turmoil
QuestInfo.0: In the midst of the branch's touble, #bGen#k calls you in secret.
QuestInfo.1: Gen orders you to dig up whatever you can on Mr. Hazard's activities in this world. Travel to the #bBack Alley#k and meet the Shadowdealer who will accompany you on your special mission.
QuestInfo.2: Coney explained that you will be investigating #m940201000# with him.

0.msg: With things going the way they are, I guess there's not much for you to gain by staying here. You have my permission to leave, if that's what you want.\r\n

1.msg: Wherever you decide to go, in Grandis or beyond, the skills you've gained here will serve you well.\r\n

2.msg: Boss, I chose to join your crew because I thought you had something to teach me. That hasn't changed. That's why I'm still here.\r\n

3.msg: Sure, it's a little lame that I can't do what I want whenever I feel like it... But my mind's already made up.\r\n

4.msg: So until I've learned all I can from you, I'm not going anywhere.\r\n

6.msg: Hah. So you're just using me for my martial arts skills and business acumen, is that it? Well, at least you're honest.\r\n

7.msg: Listen, I've got a special mission for you. But it could be dangerous. Think you can handle it?\r\n

0.msg: Danger? It's about time. I've been getting pretty tired of these rookie missions.

1.msg: I'll keep it brief... Too many prying eyes. I want you to investigate Mr. Hazard.\r\n

2.msg: It's become clear that Hazard has a patsy within our branch. There's no other way of explaining how they could take what's ours so effortlessly.\r\n

3.msg: At 11:30 PM, be at the #bBack Alley#k. A fellow Shadowdealer will be waiting for you there. He'll fill you in on the details.\r\n

no.0: Sorry to suddenly dump such a serious mission on you.\r\n
